cohort: 8,584,269 women aged 20-49 years with singleton, spontaneously conceived pregnancies from the US Nationwide Inpatient Sample (NIS) database from 2005 to 2018
finding: Endometriosis during pregnancy is associated with an increased risk of maternal and fetal complications.
mod_finding: Endometriosis during pregnancy was associated with a higher risk of Cesarean delivery.
